features.doc: The construction that expresses the causal relation.

levels.name: lexical
levels.label: lexical
levels.doc: the transitive lexical causative, with the cause as subject

levels.name: periphrastic
levels.label: periphrastic
levels.doc: the verb *cause* with an infinitival complement

levels.name: anticausative
levels.label: anticausative
levels.doc: the intransitive verb with the cause in a *from* phrase

features.doc: The sense in which the verb is used.

levels.name: abstract
levels.label: abstract
levels.doc: a figurative, psychological or otherwise abstract sense

features.doc: What the phrase naming the cause denotes.

levels.name: absence
levels.label: absence
levels.doc: an absence or omission, *the lack of sunscreen*

levels.name: fact
levels.label: fact
levels.doc: a fact, named by a *the fact that* nominal

levels.name: gerund
levels.label: gerund
levels.doc: a fact or other abstract object, named by a verbal gerund

levels.name: degree
levels.label: degree
levels.doc: a degree, named by a dimensional noun such as *quality* or *intensity*

labels.doc: The labels of the spans the rows mark.

levels.name: verb
levels.label: verb
levels.doc: the causative verb under test, or in the periphrastic frame the verb under *cause*

index.doc: The causative statements of the paper's sections 1 to 3, 4.3.1 and 6 and of its appendix.

examples.primaryText: The lack of sunscreen caused Jane's skin to burn.
